offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures business jets, turboprop aircraft, military helicopters and tiltrotor aircraft, defense vehicles and systems, and golf, turf and industrial equipment. Sells to airlines, governments, defense agencies, businesses and golf course operators, and supports products with aftermarket services.

primary_products.value: business jets; turboprop aircraft; military helicopters; tiltrotor aircraft; armored military vehicles

primary_services.value: aircraft maintenance and training; defense logistics and sustainment; aftermarket parts support

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations and private aircraft operators, commercial operators, golf course and turf managers, industrial manufacturers; B2G: US and foreign defense ministries, armed forces and government agencies

end_markets.value: aviation; defense; industrial manufacturing; golf and turf

revenue_model.value: product sales: aircraft, helicopters, defense vehicles, golf and turf vehicles, and industrial tools; service fees: aircraft maintenance, parts, training and aftermarket support; project or contract: long-term defense contracts for systems, aircraft and sustainment programs
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds aircraft, vehicles and equipment from purchased components, sold to airlines, governments and businesses; service provider: takes in aircraft and equipment for maintenance, training and logistics, sold to owners and governments

geography_served.value: global: Sales and service across North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East, and other international defense and commercial markets

specialization.value: diversified: aviation aircraft, defense systems and vehicles, and industrial and golf equipment, each with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: defense contracts and sales to large corporate and government customers; distributors / dealers: independent aircraft and golf vehicle dealers and distributors; own locations: company-owned service centers and manufacturing facilities supporting aircraft and equipment
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: aircraft certification and export controls from FAA and US defense authorities, plus international defense sales approvals
